description: Returns an ETF's constituents and their weights, heaviest first, and its sector weights, for one ETF or a comma list of up to 50. Returns `data.holdings` and the sector mix `data.sectors`. When the ticker is not an ETF, `data.is_etf` is false and both are empty; `data.is_etf: true` with zero holdings means a real ETF whose holdings are not ingested yet. The reverse lookup ("which ETFs hold NVDA") is the `etf_holders` signal on tickerbot_get_ticker, or a scan: `'SMH' = ANY(etf_holders)`.

cursor.description: Continue paging: the previous response's `next_cursor`, unchanged. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change); a page whose params differ is a 400 naming the param. On a comma list it carries each ETF's own position, so every ETF continues from its own last holding; a finished one returns an empty `holdings`.

limit.description: Holdings per page, per ETF. Max 5000 until 2027-01-12, then 1000 (an over-cap `limit` is clamped to the max, not an error; see Deprecations). When more holdings follow the page, the ETF's object carries `truncated: true` and `total` (its full holding count), and `next_cursor` pages the rest.

ticker.description: ETF symbol, or a comma-separated list of up to 50 for a response keyed by symbol. Case-insensitive. Equities are bare symbols (`NVDA`); every other class carries a prefix: rates (`R:SOFR`), crypto (`X:BTCUSD`), fx (`X:EURUSD`). Bare `BTC`/`ETH` are US-listed ETFs, not spot crypto. See Tickers.

name: tickerbot_get_etf_holdings
